name: 10_team_update
task: A PM dictates a team status update: filler dropping, number formatting, a spoken list, a name self-correction, a mid-sentence stop, and a scratch-that rewrite. The productionized version of the mockup's scripted demo.

turns.say: Okay so, um, quick update on the echo cancellation work for the team.
We shipped the new echo pipeline on Tuesday, and round trip latency is down to about forty milliseconds.
There are three things left. Tuning the noise gate, retesting on the mini speaker, and updating the setup docs.
The docs task goes to Marcus. Ah wait, no, not Marcus. It goes to Diana.
One more thing. We should probably tell the vendor that their firmware is stop.
Scratch that last part. Just say we'll follow up with the vendor next week.

judge.criteria: Reads as a crisp team update: heading, shipped-news sentence with real figures, a 3-item task list, docs task owned by Diana (never Marcus in the final), the interrupted vendor/firmware thought absent, replaced by the follow-up-next-week line.
